During the [[New Republic Era]], a '''droid''' was an [[RX-series pilot droid]] with [[Color|red]] sensors and gray and red plating served as a [[tram]]-operator on the isolated [[planet]] [[At Attin]], where<ref name="SC 101" /> he<ref name="SC 101 AD" /> [[pilot]]ed a [[school tram]] bound for [[At Attin Middle School Gamma]]. Receiving little to no respect from his [[Youngling|minor]] passengers, the [[droid]] was vulnerable to bullying, such as having [[gum]] stuck to the back of his head by unruly younglings.<ref name="SC 101" />

Around [[9 ABY]],<ref>{{SkeletonCrewDate}}</ref> the droid stopped in the suburbs of an [[Unidentified city (At Attin)|At Attin city]], where his tram was boarded by [[Neel]], [[Wim]], and a few more schoolchildren. As the droid warned his passengers to remain seated while the tram was in motion, [[Unidentified mean kid|a misbehaving youngling]] planted a piece of gum on his head. Subsequently, the droid entered an underpass, which allowed the bus to quickly reach the [[city]].<ref name="SC 101" />

==Behind the scenes==
[[RX-series pilot droid]] made his debut in "[[This Could Be a Real Adventure]]",<ref name="SC 101" /> a ''[[Star Wars: Skeleton Crew]]'' episode that premiered on [[December 2]], [[2024]].<ref>{{Twitter|StarWars|status/1861409832349172011|[[Star Wars]]|quote=Mark your calendars. 🗓️ On December 2, stream the two-episode series premiere of #SkeletonCrew, only on @DisneyPlus.|archiveurl=https://archive.ph/QwMYe}}</ref> The [[droid]]'s [[wikipedia:Grammatical person|third-person]] [[wikipedia:Personal pronoun|pronouns]] were specified in the audio description provided by [[Disney+]].<ref name="SC 101 AD" />
